refinement.conditional_source25_policy: Only profiles whose classification changes from100to50us receive25us checks at the common selected SOC and nearest lower integer SOC. A selected25us failure requires an observed common pass at a higher SOC.
refinement.method: Observe both baseline neighbors in both sensitivity modes; extend or refine each changed bracket to one SOC percentage point. Then execute a common conservative cutoff in all three modes. No flight-power or dynamics reruns.
